S_mutans_SpaP_Baseline.name: Streptococcus mutans SpaP/P1 Adhesin
S_mutans_SpaP_Baseline.description: Primary virulence factor enabling S. mutans adhesion to salivary-coated enamel. UniProt P23504.

S_mutans_GtfB_Insoluble.name: Streptococcus mutans Glucosyltransferase-B (GtfB)
S_mutans_GtfB_Insoluble.description: Synthesizes water-insoluble glucans (mutan) that form the structural backbone of EPS. UniProt P08987.

S_mutans_GtfC_Bridge.name: Streptococcus mutans Glucosyltransferase-C (GtfC)
S_mutans_GtfC_Bridge.description: Synthesizes mixed glucans for the adhesive bridge coupling the biofilm locally. UniProt P13470.

S_mutans_GtfD_Primer.name: Streptococcus mutans Glucosyltransferase-D (GtfD)
S_mutans_GtfD_Primer.description: Produces soluble glucans (dextran) that prime the other Gtf enzymes. UniProt P49331.

S_mutans_Ftf_Energy.name: Streptococcus mutans Fructosyltransferase (Ftf/fruA)
S_mutans_Ftf_Energy.description: Produces fructans for extracellular energy storage in the biofilm. UniProt Q03174.

S_sobrinus_GtfS_Matrix.name: Streptococcus sobrinus Glucosyltransferase-S (GtfS)
S_sobrinus_GtfS_Matrix.description: Rapidly converts sucrose to extracellular glucans, accelerating biofilm thickness in rampant caries. UniProt P29336.

L_casei_LDH_Acid.name: Lacticaseibacillus casei L-lactate dehydrogenase (LDH)
L_casei_LDH_Acid.description: The metabolic engine of lactic acid production, driving the local pH drop to decalcify enamel. UniProt P00343.

A_naeslundii_FimA_Adhesion.name: Actinomyces naeslundii FimA Fimbriae
A_naeslundii_FimA_Adhesion.description: Critical for pioneer colonization of the tooth pellicle and binding to GalNAcβ structures. UniProt O68212.

F_nucleatum_FadA_Adhesin.name: Fusobacterium nucleatum FadA Adhesin
F_nucleatum_FadA_Adhesin.description: The master key that bridges early streptococci with late periodontal pathogens. UniProt Q5I6B0.

P_gingivalis_RgpB_Gingipain.name: Porphyromonas gingivalis Gingipain-R2 (RgpB)
P_gingivalis_RgpB_Gingipain.description: Arg-specific protease that wrecks host tissue. UniProt P95493.

T_denticola_Dentilisin_Protease.name: Treponema denticola Dentilisin (PrtP)
T_denticola_Dentilisin_Protease.description: Major surface protease involved in tight-junction destruction. Chymotrypsin-like.

T_forsythia_BspA_Antigen.name: Tannerella forsythia BspA Surface Antigen
T_forsythia_BspA_Antigen.description: Red-complex surface antigen driving coaggregation and atherosclerosis links. UniProt O68831.

C_albicans_Als3_Synergy.name: Candida albicans Als3 (Agglutinin-like protein)
C_albicans_Als3_Synergy.description: Fungal cell surface adhesion protein that supercharges bacterial biofilm virulence and cross-kingdom anchoring. UniProt Q59L12.

S_mutans_GtfB_Scaffold.name: GtfB Inhibitory Scaffold (Residues 1176-1194)
S_mutans_GtfB_Scaffold.description: Naturally derived 19-mer peptide that acts as a specific, noncompetitive inhibitor of glucan transfer. Base for de novo refinement.

C_albicans_Mannan_Receptor.name: Candida albicans O/N-Mannan Receptor
C_albicans_Mannan_Receptor.description: Specific fungal mannan structures that provide 'Velcro' binding for GtfB (1-2 nN strength). Essential for matrix docking.

S_wiggsiae_Acid_Progressor.name: Scardovia wiggsiae Acid Engine
S_wiggsiae_Acid_Progressor.description: Emerging secondary cariogen that drives rampant early childhood caries (ECC). UniProt A9ZDY9.
